description: Records that one charge was paid, or takes the mark back with paid: false. The commitment is named by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names. The charge is a row; if no row exists for that day one is written at the commitment's price. `amount` records what left the account when it differed, and `paid_on` the day the money moved when it was not the due date; they change that one row and no other, and a null paid_on or note clears it. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

amount.description: A number, zero or more, up to 1,000,000,000,000,000.

note.description: A word about this one charge. Null clears.

paid_on.description: The day the money moved, when it was not the due date. Null clears.

name: mark_paid
title: Mark a charge paid
